title: Shiraishi An — Past Excitement〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: SEKAI are born from people's feelings and something along those lines sent us to this place...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: With that ball of light being the main culprit behind all this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So me touching that thing really sent us to a SEKAI born from different feelings...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right.
Luckily, things should go back to normal if we wait just a bit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, that's good to know.
Still...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, someone's singing!
Huh? There's someone playing guitar next to them. That's a completely different song, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah.
How are they able to play so close together?

rows.Speaker: Singer
rows.Line: Hey, buddy. Mind playing your guitar somewhere else? You're totally ruining my singing vibe...

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: You can complain all you want, but I'm already competing against someone next to me.

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: Scram if you don't like being here, or you could try out-singing me and my guitar.

rows.Speaker: Singer
rows.Line:
You're on.
Challenge accepted.

rows.Speaker: Band Member's Friend
rows.Line:
Hey, that sounds fun!
Mind if I jump in with my bass? I'll help you out.

rows.Speaker: Singer & Band Member
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: Why are you helping my opponent?!

rows.Speaker: Band Member's Friend
rows.Line:
Haha. It'll be more interesting this way.
Right, you guys?!

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Yeah! Don't let us down, alright?

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: You can do it! I believe in all of you!

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line:
Fine, you can borrow our bassist.
But you're still going down!

rows.Speaker: Singer
rows.Line: Hmph. Not until the fat lady sings!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...
It's so similar...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This place feels a lot like Vivid Street...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? You mean the place we saw in that video? I'm not really seeing it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
The buildings and stuff look way different...

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line:
Hey, not bad!
Alright, try this on for size!

rows.Speaker: Passersby
rows.Line:
This is awesome!
You guys are doing great!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. This sort of atmosphere's exactly what you used to see on Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Especially after RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: After RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. RAD WEEKEND itself was unbelievably amazing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But it was able to reach its legendary status party because of what followed.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: After that night, you could hear all these people singing and playing music early in the morning.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: As the day went on, more and more people just kept gathering...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I remember going out shopping with my mom and seeing musicians absolutely everywhere!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It looked like there were more people playing music than pedestrians!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Vivid Street's always been a place where musicians can gather, but things just blew up after that night.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They all seemed inspired to become world-class performers like my dad and his team, and go where they played.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It was just that big an event, huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Because of that night, all these people started showing up and made the demand for live houses skyrocket.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: All the while COL ended up closing, my dad retired from music, Uncle Taiga and Aunt Nagi went overseas and things started simmering down.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see. And this place's atmosphere is reminding you of what it was like back then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Call it nostalgia...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I even decided that I'm gonna be just like my dad and started singing on Vivid Street every day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: Whew! Thanks for letting me sing with you! That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Musician A
rows.Line:
That's great to hear!
But to be honest, An, your energy's what really drove us.

rows.Speaker: Musician B
rows.Line: Yeah, it's so easy to tell that you're Ken's daughter. Is singing what you wanna do when you grow up?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: And I'm gonna put on the best event ever! One that surpasses RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Musician A
rows.Line:
Haha. You got a big dream there.
Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: Hold on. Don't you guys want to become famous like my dad and his team...?

rows.Speaker: Musician A
rows.Line:
I mean, sure...
We can all dream, but reality isn't so kind.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: But what about your passion? Don't you need to keep that fire inside lit to make your dreams come true?

rows.Speaker: Musician B
rows.Line:
Yeah, you have a point...
But we're just not the kind of people to do anything great or groundbreaking, you know?

rows.Speaker: Musician A
rows.Line:
But not you, An!
You might actually pull it off, so we'll be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
Oh...
Okay, thanks...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I feel like things started to change after my dad retired and everyone started calling RAD WEEKEND “that legendary night”...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Even after I kept telling myself, “Yeah! I'm gonna be the one!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everyone started saying, “Nothing like that's ever gonna happen again,” and how, “It was on a completely different level.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which led to me not being able to find a partner or team since I kept telling everyone, “I'm gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There were so many people singing and playing music, but I'd become all alone somehow.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, except Akito... I think he was the only person I met who also kept saying the same thing as me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Cool! Way to go, Akito!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Unfortunately, he'd already found a partner by that point.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was so desperate to find someone who could chase after the same dream as me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And that's when I met...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?! Wait, now what?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, is it time to go back...?
bgm_area00003

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Looks like it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohaneee!
I missed you so much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Eep! A-An?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You sound like someone who's been united with a long, lost family member or something.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, don't you remember that we spent half of yesterday practicing together...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Haha. Cut her some slack.
I mean, to An, Kohane's...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The best partner ever!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Exactly!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (A lot of time's passed since that night...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But I have the best partner ever and a team who shares the same dream as me!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay! Let's do our best again today!
And keep doing everything we can to surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Akito & Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Yes.
